native_mechanisms: Hang the two symbol strings on crossed row/column lamp-posts, forming a lattice of lazily-lit cells whose spark colour (match / gap-in / gap-out) is chosen by the crossing symbol pair.
Fold the lattice sheet along its slanting middle so all cells with equal row+column sum press into a single crease (anti-diagonal wavefront processed as one unit).

Read the three stacked crease layers (current + two prior diagonals) at once, taking the best of straight-through vs. one-slip, and let the spent bottom layer drift off — keeping only the two most recent creases.
core_technique: Anti-diagonal (wavefront) Needleman-Wunsch: each anti-diagonal d = i+j is computed as one vector pass from the two previous anti-diagonals held in three rotating buffers, with one sequence pre-reversed so the diagonal becomes a contiguous SIMD-friendly stride-1 span, vectorised with AVX2/AVX-512BW 16-bit lanes (32-bit variant past the 16-bit score range, scalar two-row DP only for n < 32).
